note: Concatenation of operands that are all different widths - scalar, byte, nibble, sized literal - where concat_slice.v joins two four-bit vectors and so cannot tell a tool that mislaid a width from one that did not. The four operands here are 1 + 8 + 4 + 3 into exactly 16 bits, and the second output builds eight bits from a slice of a wider signal, which is another operand kind. Behavioral because a field placed one bit out is still a legal concatenation filling the same output.
